messages:
taylor: Deploybot flagged preflight eval regression for summarizer:v3.2 — extractive precision -6.2% vs baseline, hallucination score +3.1. Can we triage and decide pin vs rollback? @maria @sam

deploy-bot: ALERT: preflight-eval FAILED for manifest summarizer:v3.2 at 2490001234. Failed checks: quality_gate, safety. Suggested actions: pin to summarizer:v3.1 or rollback canary. Commands: `/deploybot info summarizer:v3.2`, `/deploybot rollback canary <version>`

sam: Looking. Canary is still at 10% traffic, no ramp since 06:00 PT. Maria, can you pull the failing checkpoints from the prompt suite?

maria: Loading the prompt slice now. Quick findings: regression concentrated on long-doc extraction prompts (len>5k). Q/A family shows biggest delta. Recommendation: rollback — delta > alert thresholds across 3/5 eval families.

jordan: Is this user-visible or just internal eval noise? Need to know whether to notify PMs/customers.

maria: Latency unaffected. It's a quality regression only. EU nightly batch jobs that create customer-facing summaries could be impacted.

anna: Oncall here — change window open. Rollback is safe within window; runbook: `rollback --to summarizer:v3.1 --force --reason "preflight regression 2490001234"`. Note: clear KV cache on workers after rollback to avoid stale prefix hits.

sam: Options: 1) Pin canary back to v3.1 and bisect against the long-doc set (slower), 2) Immediate rollback and halt rollout. Leaning rollback since core Q/A delta >5%.

maria: :+1: rollback unless we can reproduce locally within 30m. I can start bisect after rollback.

taylor: Agree rollback. @deploy-bot please initiate rollback canary -> summarizer:v3.1 and open an incident ticket for investigation. I'll update release notes.

deploy-bot: CMD: `/deploybot rollback canary summarizer:v3.1`
Status: queued
Triggered by: taylor
ETA: ~3m — executing pre-rollback checks

sam: I'll notify SRE and Product. @jordan please draft a short customer-facing blurb: 'We temporarily rolled back summarizer to v3.1 due to a preflight quality regression. Investigating; will update in 2h.'

jordan: On it. Pinging PMs. Legal not needed yet.

maria: After rollback, we'll run a narrow bisect using long-doc prompts only and capture failing traces. I'll kick that off.

anna: Rollback in progress. I'll monitor logs and smoke tests.

deploy-bot: UPDATE: rollback succeeded at 2490001460. Canary reverted to summarizer:v3.1. Post-rollback smoke checks: passed.

taylor: Closing the loop — created GH #4821 with traces, failing prompts, and suggested bisect plan. Tagging eng-ml and infra. Thanks everyone.

sam: :thumbsup:

maria: Starting bisect job now, will post results in the issue.
